name: Full AttnRes with Canon layers A–D
tagline: Every block its own depth source, and short causal convolutions on every sublayer input, on q, k, v and in the MLP.
description: Full AttnRes, one group per block, so each sublayer reads the embedding and every earlier block's output separately, with Canon layers at all four positions as in Block AttnRes with Canon layers A–D. Canon weights start at zero. The 138 Canon layers (six per block) add 1,271,808 parameters; calibrated to +0.486% of the shared budget at 23 layers / FFN 6144.
paperTitle: Physics of Language Models: Part 4.1, Architecture Design and the Magic of Canon Layers
mechanism: Full AttnRes: 23 depth groups of one block; zero-initialized pseudo-queries over the embedding and every block output
Canon-A/C: a 4-tap causal depthwise convolution with a residual on every attention and FFN input
Canon-B on q, k, v and Canon-D on the 6144-wide MLP hidden; all Canon weights start at zero
limitations: Found by an LLM agent with NextT-Gym in arena v1 (involvement L2) and selected on the dev split at a 2,000-update prefix with one seed; no formal run yet, so it has no published result. The gym's selection measured −0.00380 BPB against attnres at that prefix; gaps that small may change after the learning-rate decay of a full run. The Canon layers are eager PyTorch depthwise convolutions without fused kernels: in the gym trainer one update took 1.66 times attnres's time, a property of this implementation rather than of the method. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
